title: Vytorin Reexamination Study (0653A-174)
brief_summary: This survey is conducted for preparing application material for re-examination under the Pharmaceutical Affairs Laws and its Enforcement Regulation, its aim is to reconfirm the clinical usefulness of VYTORIN through collecting the safety and efficacy information according to the Re-examination Regulation for New Drugs.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Participants Who Receives Vytorin In Usual Medical Practice Within Local Label For The First Time
study_population: Participants with Primary Hypercholesterolemia and Homozygous Familial Hypercholesterolemia (HoFH) treated with Vytorin
condition: Primary Hypercholesterolemia and Homozygous Familial Hypercholesterolemia (HoFH)
